procedural_matters: the panel is constituted under N1.4
facts: Rule 61.2(b) does require for a redress the end of protest time or two hours after the incident.
The request for redress was 13 minutes after the end of protest time received.
The end of the protest time was one hour after the last finisher of the bronze fleet. The silver fleet was also in between.
decision: The request for redress is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
